title: Kitab Ghar Main Application & Book Genie Hero
purpose: Initial render of the main Kitab Ghar React Router SPA homepage.
what_it_demonstrates: The React Router client layout, active navigation, official branding logo, Book Genie reading guide hero and featured catalogue cards in the main application.

title: Interactive Book Genie Recommendation Wizard
what_it_demonstrates: The interactive Book Genie recommendation wizard rendered conditionally as an interactive modal with dynamic questions, option cards and progress tracking.

title: Live Books Catalogue Route (/books)
purpose: Main API-backed catalogue route with search, filters and sorting.
what_it_demonstrates: The client-side BooksPage component fetching and rendering the 77-book API catalogue with live search, category filter pills, availability toggles and sorting.

title: Dynamic Parameter Route (/books/:id)
purpose: Dynamic route rendering book record by ID parameter.
what_it_demonstrates: The dynamic parameter route extracting book ID with useParams, fetching record details via useApiData, and displaying cover artwork, stock availability and rental actions.

title: Reader Membership Plans Route (/membership)
purpose: Dedicated subscription tiers page with UPI integration.
what_it_demonstrates: The dedicated membership route with live subscription tiers (Basic, Standard, Bibliophile) and interactive UPI QR payment modal integration.

title: Controlled Authentication Route (/login)
purpose: Reader login screen with controlled form state.
what_it_demonstrates: Controlled form inputs for reader authentication, error feedback, and programmatic navigation redirection via useNavigate.

title: Protected Reader Dashboard Route (/dashboard)
purpose: Protected user dashboard displaying active loans and account status.
what_it_demonstrates: The reader dashboard route guarded by ProtectedRoute, rendering active rental metrics, payment status, and library exploration CTAs.

title: Responsive Mobile SPA Layout (320px)
purpose: Mobile responsiveness capture at 320px viewport width.
what_it_demonstrates: Responsive React Router layout and Book Genie hero adapting cleanly to a 320px mobile viewport without horizontal scrolling.
